title: Vibrant Energizing Korean Redcurrants Gui
description: A cultured and glassy-jelly Korean dish from the Gyeongsang region, featuring redcurrants and made with a mortar and pestle, perfect for an energizing snack. This egg-free friendly recipe is a unique and delicious treat.
instructions: Rinse the redcurrants and pick out any stems or debris.
In a mortar and pestle, pound the redcurrants with the korean chili flakes until well combined.
In a small saucepan, combine the honey, rice vinegar, and water, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium and simmer for 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the agar agar powder and salt.
Add the agar agar mixture to the saucepan and whisk until dissolved.
Add the pounded redcurrant mixture to the saucepan and whisk until well combined.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let cool to room temperature.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13 inch dish and refrigerate until set, about 3 hours.
Cut into desired shapes and garnish with pine nuts.
